name: Micaiah
overview: Micaiah, the son of Imlah, is a prophet who boldly reproved King Ahab despite the king's dislike for him because he did not prophesy favorably (1 Kings 22:8). Summoned by the king, Micaiah stood apart from the other prophets who uniformly predicted victory over the Syrians (1 Kings 22:9-12). Even when urged to align his words with the flattering messages of the other prophets, Micaiah remained faithful to the true word of the LORD, demonstrating the courage and integrity required to proclaim God's truth regardless of popular opinion (1 Kings 22:13).
